prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a heavy four-legged beast seen from the side with a hide of cracked grey stone plates and exactly three different heads on short thick necks from the shoulders, the same three in every cell and each clearly apart: one scaly grey lizard head with a spiky crest and yellow eyes high on top, one curled-horn ram head in the middle (only one ram head), and one maned grey lion head low in front; no wings, a short thick stone tail; the whole beast, tail to snout, sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: the three heads (lizard, ram and lion) are clearly readable, the lion face with amber eyes in front.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging forward low with the lion head roaring toward the heroes, the lizard head and the ram head staying on top of the shoulders exactly as in the idle cell (three heads in all, no new head), the heads above and just in front of its front feet, all four feet on the ground, the whole beast well inside the middle cell; no breath, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, all four feet on the ground, the lion head flinching with the eyes shut, the lizard head and the ram head staying on top of the shoulders exactly as in the idle cell (three heads in all, no new head), a crack across the stone hide, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body but keep all four feet on the ground and the body low (no leap, no rearing up): reach the heads toward the heroes with the necks bent so every head stays well inside its own cell; the tail stays close to the body. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on four legs seen from the side, every paw on the ground line unless it is lifted to strike or rear. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, wings, a snake tail, a goat head, a dragon head, a fourth head, two ram heads, tawny fur, fire breath, rearing up, impact lines.
